items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] …Stanley Turrentine! [INTERVIEWEE] Joe Farrell, Little Esther [Phillips], Hank Crawford. We used to take CTI over to Europe.

ctx.x: Joe Farrell, Little Esther [Phillips], Hank Crawford. We used to take CTI over to Europe. Actually, we went to Europe when they were having the Olympics and it was a tragic time there…
